notes.title: Bun has been Cancelled
notes.content:
[b] I am sorry to say that Bun has been officially cancelled.[/b] During the planning phase of trying to revamp the platforming, story and pet mechanics, I started to realize how much time each of these upgrades would take just didn't match up with the amount of time I have available to make games as a solo developer. It took me a while to come to terms with this, but I know it's for the best that I move on and get to work applying everything I learned to something new.

Thank you all so much for your support over the last few years. I couldn't have gotten as far as I did without you.
- Erik

To follow what comes next for my game development journey...
